decisions.title: Which legal name, postal address, governing law and courts should the Terms name?
options: England and Wales law and courts, with a consumer home-court exception; owner supplies legal name and address
Law of the owner's country of residence, with a consumer home-court exception
Delaware or California law, with a consumer home-court exception
decisions.recommended: England and Wales law and courts, with a consumer home-court exception; owner supplies legal name and address
decisions.answer: England and Wales law and courts; publisher Lumoxia.Art; notices to info@lumoxia.art; no postal address

decisions.title: Include an arbitration clause and class-action waiver?
options: No arbitration and no class waiver (courts plus informal resolution)
US-only arbitration with class waiver and 30-day opt-out
decisions.recommended: No arbitration and no class waiver (courts plus informal resolution)
decisions.answer: No arbitration and no class waiver (courts plus informal resolution)

decisions.title: Translate the Terms into all 15 languages now, marked unreviewed, with English prevailing?
options: Yes, all 15 languages in one change, English prevails
decisions.recommended: Yes, all 15 languages in one change, English prevails
decisions.answer: Yes, all 15 languages in one change, English prevails

decisions.title: Store the publisher name and notices email as build-time constants that fail the build when empty?
options: Yes, constants in scripts/build.py, build fails closed
Put them in each language's strings
decisions.recommended: Yes, constants in scripts/build.py, build fails closed
decisions.answer: Yes, constants in scripts/build.py, build fails closed
